result.title: TriGeoBench: A Multimodal Mathematical Geometry Benchmark with Figures and TikZ
result.comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables, including appendices. The first four authors contributed equally
result.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models show strong vision-language capabilities, yet their geometry-centric reasoning remains insufficiently understood. Existing mathematical benchmarks typically rely on rasterized figures and cover limited geometric knowledge areas and response formats, making it difficult to assess whether models reason over geometric structures or exploit superficial visual patterns. We introduce TriGeoBench, a geometry-centric multimodal benchmark constructed from Chinese middle- and high-school mathematics examinations. TriGeoBench contains 7,000 question-answer pairs and 12,235 geometric figures with TikZ code, spanning plane geometry, solid geometry, analytic geometry, function, and vector geometry across diverse response formats. Each instance forms a {question-answer pair, image, TikZ} triplet: question-answer pairs are stored in LaTeX, images as RGB figures, and TikZ preserves geometric topology, symbolic annotations, and relational structure. We evaluate representative open- and closed-source MLLMs through image-to-TikZ and multimodal reasoning probes. Results reveal persistent fine-grained structure and image-text alignment challenges. Oracle experiments with human-curated reference TikZ suggest that accurate executable representations provide complementary geometric cues; they do not evaluate an end-to-end conversion pipeline. TriGeoBench offers a testbed for structure-aware mathematical reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 构建面向中国初高中几何的多模态基准 TriGeoBench，含 7000 组问答、12235 幅几何图及对应 TikZ 代码，形成「问答-图像-TikZ」三元组，并用图像到 TikZ 转换与多模态推理探针评测代表性 MLLM，另设人工 TikZ 的 oracle 对照。
AI.relevance_reason: 几何拓扑与符号关系能否被模型真正使用、模型是否依赖表层视觉模式，正对应视觉细节与关系信息是否保留在内部状态的问题；其 TikZ 可执行结构与 oracle 设置可供核查结构化视觉证据对推理的贡献，但未涉及 latent 状态生成与训练机制。
